title: dimensions combination overrides
description: Editor aid for overrides/<a>+<b>.json; the file name lists the dimensions in alphabetical order, and overrides nest one level per dimension in that order. The dimensions compiler is the authority: it also checks the nesting depth, that values, types, nodes, states and attribute values exist and are in scope, and that overrides do not conflict, which this schema cannot express.

$schema.description: Path or URL of this schema, for editors.

overrides.description: Overrides by the first dimension's values, then the next dimension's, down to the overrides for that combination.

name.description: Non-blank, without leading or trailing whitespace or control characters.

valueOverrides.description: What changes for types and nodes when the dimension has this value.

nodes.description: Overrides by node id; applied after the node's type override.

states.description: States removed from or added to the type in this context.

customAttributes.description: Custom attribute values in this context, by attribute name, then by state.
